sentences.text:
Author: N.Tukaramji
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No. 3380 Of 2025
Order

Heard Mr. M. Janardhan Rao, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, representing the respondent No.1-State.
2.

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) seeking quashment of Non-Bailable Warrant dated 12.02.2025 in C.C. No. 677 of 2023 on the file of XIV Additional Judge-Cum-XVIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, City Criminal Courts, Secunderabad.

entities.text: XIV Additional Judge-Cum-XVIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, City Criminal Courts, Secunderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner/accused is facing accusation under Sections 409, 420, 506 IPC.
4. Today, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is ready to appear before the Court below with an application to recall the NBW.
However, considering the health condition pleaded and ongoing Ramzan fasting, a direction may be issued to the trial Court to consider the application and pass orders on the same day.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor reported no specific objection.
6. I have considered the submissions of learned counsel and perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the submissions, the petitioner is directed to appear in person before the trial Court on 17.03.2025 with an appropriate application for recall of NBW, whereupon the learned XIV Additional Judge-Cum-XVIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, City Criminal Courts,
Secunderabad, is directed to consider the application on its own merits and pass appropriate orders on the same day.
